title: How Did Medieval Londoners Go to the Toilet?
description:
How did people go to the toilet in medieval London? Public latrines, household cesspits and the night work of gong farmers reveal a less glamorous side of city life in 1390.

title: 7 Years, No Wife: Life as a Medieval Apprentice
description:
An apprenticeship in medieval London meant at least seven years learning a trade—and no marriage until the term was done. Your master provided food, housing and training. In return, you worked and obeyed.
